title: geranium caespitosum subsp. atropurpureum
intro: Geranium caespitosum subsp. atropurpureum, commonly known as Mountain Cranesbill, is a succulent perennial plant that belongs to the Geraniaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, such as relieving anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Mountain Cranesbill include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
